\node[card] (a) {\heading{1}{評価ファイバーと非障害部分}{Evaluation fiber and unobstructed locus}
$F=\mathrm{ev}^{-1}(x),\quad h=d-2,\quad b=ad,\quad [F]^{\mathrm{vir}}|_U=[U]$\\
\Tx{$\beta$ は free、$x$ は非常に一般、$U$ は既約な源を持つ写像}{$\beta$ is free; $x$ is very general; $U$ has irreducible source.}};
\node[card,below=3.2cm of a] (b) {\heading{2}{印以外を共通零点へ縮約}{Contract unmarked trees to common zeros}
$\Phi:F\longrightarrow W,\quad \psi=\Phi^*\xi,\quad 1\le w_j\le b$\\
\Tx{印の近傍と cotangent line を保ち、$U$ 上の generic degree は1}{The marking and cotangent line are preserved; generic degree on $U$ is one.}};
\flow{a}{b}{\Tx{全次数を印の成分へ移す。}{Move all degree to the marked component.}\\\Cite{contraction}\\\Tx{印の近傍を保つ縮約の別構成：}{Alternative contraction preserving the marking:}\\\Cite{intermediate-construction}};
\node[card,below=2.5cm of b] (c) {\heading{3}{境界の押し出しを消す}{Kill the pushed-forward boundary}
$\dim\Phi(F\setminus U)\le d_0+u-2\le h-1$\\
$\Phi_*[F]^{\mathrm{vir}}=\sum_\alpha[\overline{\Phi(U_\alpha)}]\ne0$\quad\Tx{有効 $h$-cycle}{effective $h$-cycle}};
\flow{b}{c}{\Tx{各 tail の次数 $\ge\iota\ge2$ と Chow localization を使う。}{Use degree $\ge\iota\ge2$ for each tail and Chow localization.}\\\Cite{boundary}\\\Tx{仮想類そのものの有効性は不要。}{Effectivity of the virtual class itself is not required.}};
\node[result,below=2.4cm of c] (d) {\heading{4}{重み付き次数から定量的下界}{A quantitative bound from weighted degree}
$\displaystyle \langle\tau_{d-2}(\mathrm{pt})\rangle_\beta
=\int_{\Phi_*[F]^{\mathrm{vir}}}\xi^h\ge b^{-(h+1)}=(ad)^{-(d-1)}$};
\flow{c}{d}{\Tx{座標部分スタックの次数 $1/(w_0\cdots w_h)$ と射影公式。}{Use coordinate-substack degree $1/(w_0\cdots w_h)$ and projection formula.}\\\Cite{degree-bound}};
